description: One Base read of the market pulse: a score from 0 to 100, risk-on or risk-off, five reasons, and the sources that answered. Public data only. Not financial advice. $0.005 per call over x402 (USDC on Base only). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.
